text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said the European Commission's evaluation of Lithuania was unobjective and based on politics, and that the rate of inflation in Lithuania in 1996 was not 24 percent, as stated in its conclusion, but 13 percent.

- From August 1996 to June 1997 the privatisation agency privatised 140 objects, worth 21.929 million litas. Sixty-four objects were sold through the agency, 18 through the stock exchange, 58 through local governments and 77 through public auction. Four were rented with the option to buy.

- Presidential candidate Vaidotas Zhukas told reporters Lithuania's membership in the European Union will be dangerous to the country's culture and agriculture and that he was sceptical about his chances to win the December election.
